rules.accepted_credit_types: Continuing education related to nursing practice; formal CEU/CNE accreditation is not required; hours from other states or countries count
rules.new_licensee_rule: Requirements start with the first full renewal date after licensure (new graduates and endorsement). New licensees have until their 2nd renewal to complete the health equity hours.
rules.audit_note: No documentation is sent at renewal; the Board recommends keeping CE and practice-hour records at least 2 years and may request them in an investigation.

topics.who: Counts toward the 8 hours; first due by the 2026 renewal; health equity courses include implicit bias training
One-time training in suicide assessment, treatment and management from a qualified program

rules.notes: Annual renewal on the birthday. Besides 8 CE hours, 96 hours of nursing practice per year are required (24 hours for retired active status). Demographic data must be submitted in the renewal portal.
